description: Header file defining interfaces, constants, macros, enums, and data structures for WAN manager RBUS handler APIs, including device configuration, event handling, and remote device management.

methods.name: WanMgr_IDM_Invoke
methods.description: Sends an invoke request to IDM with specified parameters.

methods.name: WanMgr_Rbus_Init
methods.description: Initializes the RBUS interface for WAN management.

methods.name: WanMgr_Rbus_Exit
methods.description: Cleans up and exits the RBUS interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_Rbus_EventPublishHandler
methods.description: Publishes an event with a specific DM event name, value, and type.

methods.name: WanMgr_Rbus_String_EventPublish
methods.description: Publishes a string event with a given DM event name and value.

methods.name: WanMgr_Rbus_String_EventPublish_OnValueChange
methods.description: Publishes a string event when the value changes, with previous and current values.

methods.name: WanMgr_Rbus_getUintParamValue
methods.description: Retrieves a uint parameter value from the RBUS.

methods.name: WanMgr_RestartUpdateRemoteIface
methods.description: Restarts and updates remote interface configuration.

methods.name: WanMgr_WanRemoteIfaceConfigure
methods.description: Configures remote WAN interface based on device change event.

methods.name: WanManager_ManageInterfaceStatusSubscription
methods.description: Manages subscription to interface status changes.

methods.name: WanMgr_SubscribeDhcpClientEvents
methods.description: Subscribes to DHCP client events for a specified interface.

methods.name: WanMgr_UnSubscribeDhcpClientEvents
methods.description: Unsubscribes from DHCP client events for a specified interface.
